review_description: The quotation process was seamless. The sales manager came out to review the site. Dion and the crew did a great job installing. Had to take a pause due to rain and wind. They were tidy and polite, generally good guys. I still have a few questions about the next steps with my energy supplier.

We installed a sigenergy 24kw battery to our solar system. We went with solarworx as they were the most thorough and informative company.  No question was to hard for them. Always had quick response to any queries. Two weeks after agreeing to contract, had a phone call,  crew was in area and could install the next day. Install crew arrived on time, were very polite and helpful. 4 hours later all finished and cleaned up.  Great service,  great install   great communication.  I would recommend solarworx to anyone needing solar/battery.
Matrix Solar have been fantastic to deal with.  Great customer service, product and price. We would highly recommend them.

The sales/quote process was very easy and was explained in great detail. I had a few more questions before I made my decision and contacting them and getting a response was extremely fast. Installer went well and the team were very polite, tidy and very punctual. Yes they help organise the grid connection but waiting for my electricity provider to connect after 10 days still hadn't happened Matrix contacted me and came back out the next day to connect me straight away.

From the first meeting I could tell this company was going to be the one I used. They  listened and provided the exact system I was looking for. 2 days later they were at the house installing it. Thanks again crew and would highly recommend matrix solar

We're okay as far as installation, politeness and equipment supplied.New roof was heavily damaged and awaiting repair of one side of the house. Wrong fuses used and fridges destroyed on commissioning and told bad luck not their fault even though wrong fuses used and replaced three times and then again told bad luck when cooktop burnt out after fuses were changed a third time.Still waiting for roof repair after 1 month.

We are old school. Preferred face to face interaction. We have done research but by no means were we experts. In the sales pitch, we were looking for indications of knowledge, review and advice relating to our location and what would work and what would not. We got four quotes in the end. Three via SolarQuotes and one more from our insurer who has a good reputation. We did not go with the insurer because:1. Phone contact only. No site visit to consider or discuss installation expectations/ limitations.2. No indication of which installation company/ subcontractor was actually going to do the job.3. Pricing was somewhat ($4000 - $5000) more than all the other quotes - For very comparable systems and features.Installation process was incredible to watch. Five Electricians on the job. They all knew what they were doing. They were efficient, tidy and professional. They operated like a well oiled machine. The Lead Electrician regularly kept us updated on what was happening. We even had the Company Director visit to ensure everything was proceeding to plan. Additionally, we asked to have bird proofing installed. As we have quite a roosting pigeon problem here. Done the next day just as efficiently as the system instal.Installation and commissioning was completed in the one day. The Lead Electrician was very thorough in walking us through how the system operated, safety switching, monitoring and use of the online app.Cannot fault this company in any way. They were top notch.

Whilst Andrew was prompt in responding to our request for a quote and his presentation and explanation of the Sungrow battery, his follow up with a written quote, any further questions and adjusted quotes was very ordinary at best, in fact I had to chase him on a number of occasions just to keep the process moving. Whilst we accepted his quote in early December we are still waiting on an installation date and in fact I believe I will need to again chase him in The new year
Great process from first sit down through to the install.
Comprehensive advice about available options, including on price and positioning alternatives. No hard sell. Quality and timely installation.
Non pushy sales side of things made it more comfortable to make the decision. Installers were professional and answered any and all questions happily.

Matrix were 1 of 3 quotes we had via SolarQuotes website. We also had a 4th installer out to quote. Andrew from Matrix was more informative than the others and answered all of our questions. The pricing was also competitive. We had a complete solar panel, inverter and battery system installed within 3 weeks of initial quote from Matrix.Installation was tidy and professional. Unfortunately we weren't around when they finished the job so we were not able to be shown any components of the system on the app. However, the app is simple to use and even though we haven't had our first bill yet, we can see from the app how well the solar and battery system is working for us.Thank Andrew and Matrix.

Andrew attended our house in the Southern Fleurieu to measure and quote. He explained what could be done and what would not work.The installation was fast and trouble free.Dion and his crew were courteous, thoughtful and very through in their work. They left the site very clean.Dion showed me how the app worked and which circuits were wired into the battery in case of a blackout.He demonstrated how the HWS timer worked.Overall I am very happy with both the product and service provided by Andrew, Dion and their team.

Andrew from Matrix Solar responded very quickly to our request for a quote, of the 3 quotes he was only one to come to our residence for an in person quote and quote was hence best tailored to our needs. Every question was well answered and the end quote was way better value for money than other other quotes.Install happened 3 days later thanks to a free spot in Matrix's schedule and the job was was completed by a team of 5 the same day.Dion and Andrew were more than happy to assist with any questions and queries pre, during and post job.I highly recommend Matrix solar.

Even  questions I didn't know I needed to ask were answered patiently, and comprehensively.Installers were punctual, polite and very tidy.Explained the app very clearly.Everything seems to be working. Haven't had first electricity bill  yet.Solar quotes checklist was a great start to the process, as it sometimes felt like comparing apples and peanuts. Possibly could be extended, and/or simplified for those of us with zero knowledge  of  the process. Thanks for the starter.

Quoting was very informative and promptThe installers were very tidy and polite.  There was a small mishap where one installer went through a wall but he patched it up instantly.I was assisted with the grid connection and my questions were answered
Didn’t have to worry about organising anything Matrix sorted it all out for me

Matrix were professional and polite, they advised us on the process and the best system for our needs. Everything was up and running perfect. We will be adding a battery through Matrix in the coming months. Andrew was helpful and answered all our questions.
Communicated well and managed to fit us in earlier due to another site postponing their install.Installers were fast and efficient
Out of all the quotes I obtained Andrew was the only one to do a site inspection.

Contact after introduction was very quick as was the follow up to visit site and provide a quote. Installation timing was well within the nominated time frame although I followed up to confirm date for installation. The installation team was prompt arriving in the time frame advised and worked very efficiently. The old system was removed and the new system installed on a two storey house within 6 hours - very satisfied with workmanship and the team that did the work. The system has been performing well and as specified since installation.
Will recommend to friends and family, awesome humans who made the process completely stress free.

I am a little disappointed in after sales service about giving us a good deal on a battery extensions especially when i payed the invoice within hours of receiving it so it would have been niece to have given us are reasonable on the battery that's all.

Andrew visited our house and spent a nearly two hours explaining the details of solar systems and installations. He was very friendly and helpful. The Installation process was streamlined, with no hassles. They organised the grid connection after the installation. All very seamless.

Quick to call and supply a quote. Attended and installed quickly and efficiently with minimum disruption to the household.Would give a 5-star review but unfortunately took multiple calls to get a follow up to a minor issue. The issue was resolved quickly once I received a response. Wanted some additional work done and asked for a quote 3 times and am still waiting even after finally receiving a phone call and following up by emails. Ended up getting extra work done through another company.The initial consult was good, installers were efficient and professional, after-sales service was woeful.
Prompt response from quite to installation. Everything cleaned up. Honest in quoting the system for now and the future.  Generally good people to deal with.
The sales and quoting was very quick. The install was about a week later. So it happened quite quickly.  We were happy with our quote and the service from sales to install.

We finally got our solar active in May after a long and frustrating experience with Matrix Solar with significant cost and time blowouts. The initial meeting, in November 2022, was informative and we received a competitive quote that day. We initially accepted it on December 5 and were asked to send through a power bill. We then heard nothing until I chased them up on Dec 20. We were told the install would happen between 23 and 27 Jan, which was fine since we were away early Jan. Again, we heard nothing and I chased them up on Jan 21. They suggested the 25th and we agreed, asking for details including anything we needed to have ready, details, and what to expect, but received no response.On the 25th, workmen arrived and began the install. We were informed quickly that we needed an ungraded meterbox to continue with installation. We asked why this wasn't discovered earlier and were told it was not possible. Speaking to other installers afterwards, we were told proper site inspection is standard practice and would have revealed the issue. After a lot of back and forth, Matrix said their electrical arm could carry out the upgrade for $2600 plus "$200 - 300" for SA Power to reconnect, and that they were dependent on SA Power for the date this could occur. We asked for a quote for the electrical work and confirmation in writing but received no response. The price proposed was competitive, but a significant extra cost to the original quote.We were finally contacted by SA Power on March 19, saying the upgrade would occur on 27 April and cost $1544. We contacted Matrix that day, very unimpressed that the original timeline had gone from 6 weeks and was now over three months, and the original cost of around $7000 was now over $11000. We asked for a full breakdown of the costs, a written quote, and the reasons for the SA Power cost being so high. We were called that day and given various excuses, but had to chase up our request and finally received the information 11 days later. We were told the electrical work would be completed in the days before 27 April.On 24 April, we had received no communication and again chased up Matrix asking for the day the work would be done, times we needed to be home, etc. The reason given for the lack of communication was that different parts of the business use different spreadsheets.The work was finally all completed on 27/4, and we were generally impressed with the workers. The new meterbox was installed neatly and we have not had any issues since. The instructions given when the solar was connected were clear and they helped set up monitoring apps and left the area clean.The final frustration was being told by our energy supplier six weeks later that they had never been notified that we had solar, so our exports were not active. I understand if this was an issue on their end, but being told to check this would have been nice, and there was no post-install contact at all.Overall, the installation staff were professional, polite, and efficient, the system is good quality, work was neat, and no technical issues since the install. The price and time blowouts left us very dissatisfied, but the lack of professionalism and communication from Matrix made the process much more frustrating than it should have been. We understand unforeseen costs and delays occur, especially when dealing with SA Power, but customers should not be left wondering and chasing up responses.
Great company to deal with, prompt install, totally took care of the grid connection after the install and great follow up.Would highly recommend.

Andrew did a good job explaining everything and making clear what would be done, and the best position for the panels.In the end I went with Matrix because they could do the job much sooner than the rest, even though their price was little higher. In fact Andrew rang back the next day (Saturday) and said they could do the job on Monday three days earlier than originally planned. Now that doesn’t happen very often.The installers were great - polite, tidy and punctual and completed the job promptly and I got half a day’s worth of electricity production so the grid connection happened right away.Only one issue was the installers had to move the TV antenna a little higher up the roof which meant it caught more wind and blew over in a freak high wind storm a few days after the installation and almost hit a panel. I had to act quickly and had our maintenance men remove it and they had it reinstalled by another electrician. I spoke with Andrew about it and he said that, if I’d rang him, they would have fixed the issue at no cost. We are currently negotiating a partial reimbursement.I would recommend this company. The installers are employed by Matrix and do a great job.
Clarity in the run up to the install.Best system based in value and needs.System is working well.Follow up has been great. Minor issues resolved quickly.

Andrew from Matrix solar was unbelievable to deal with and great personal skills for the client. He made the whole process very simple and efficient. Top bloke and great workforce.Would highly recommend his services to anyone wanting solar at reasonable price

Matrix was the only company that quoted that visited the property, and Andrew was thorough in discussing our existing usage and potential future needs.  The proposed system was very similar to others, not the cheapest (by $50) but stood out as it included a Fronius Primo GEN24 inverter (software upgradable to become a hybrid inverter), rather than a cheaper model.The panel installation occured within a fortnight, in the lead up to Xmas.  Unfortunately, the inverter had to be installed a couple of days later due to a shipping delay.  Not Matrix's fault at all - just what happens with freight at that time of year.  Installer was on time, willing to answer questions, and did a good job of cleaning up (both visits).My electricity retailler (Simply Energy) doesn't have a web portal for solar installations, but Andrew provided me with all the info I needed to get smart meter installation arranged with them.  The smart meter is now in and I'm waiting on Simply Energy to get up to speed at their end.  In short very happy with Matrix Solar Solutions.
Good. Feel like we got a good deal. And future proofed our options.

Matrix Solar were able to complete my installation and provide a bigger system than I was expecting at no additional cost.  With the terrible weather occurring around the country Matrix were flexible enough to change the install date for a good weather day.  Communications were excellent and the system has since performed well beyond my expectations

Personal friendly service, receptive to my particular requirements and a good value system offered. Only a short wait for installation which was trouble free. Organised grid connection after liaising with energy provider

Sales process was good. I wouldn’t say any better than the service I received from the other 2 companies. I went with Matrrix due to the quality of the product and the price.  Once I signed up the customer service dropped off from the sales person.The installation wasn’t as easy as they expected as I had an existing enphase micro inverter system to contend with.  I requested a fronius consumption meter which didn’t arrive on the day off install instead they wired it up to my enphase envoy-s meter. This took approximately a week to sort out before the system was fully installed and functioning. Sounds good in principle, having one monitoring app, but I’m now unable to monitor the performance of the 2 new arrays. Will contact the company to see if there is any way around this.

Was one of 2 quoters who visited us, 1 was phone only. Provided additional knowledge about inverters that I was not aware of. Installation was within a few days of acceptance, quick and efficient. Available on phone to answer minor questions. Sorted out a problem with the request for new smart meter (paperwork). Small section of framework that projected off roof was promptly removed when asked.

The quote process was relatively simple and quick with no issues. Salesperson was pleasant and professional. Installation went flawlessly with the guys managing to fit our install in about 2 weeks sooner than I expected. Installers arrived on time and removed and tidied up all rubbish before they left. Did not even know they had been if I did not look at the roof. Have asked some basic questions about the Fronius monitoring system which have yet to be answered but overall a very professional, hassle free process through Matrix Solar Solutions

From the beginning, Troy impressed me with his presentation, communication and information. He was patient answering my questions as a novice and explained things fully. I was happy with the balance of quality product and a price I can afford.Andy organised installation and that all went smoothly. I was impressed when his communication continued after hours. The actual installation went smoothly and I impressed that the installers cleaned up after themselves.The system has been up and operational for less than a month. Everything seems to be going fine but I'm yet to see how the savings play out. That will take a while I'm sure, given that it's winter and we've had quite a bit of rain and grey days.So far, so good
Andrew was very helpful and being an electrician meant he could give informed advice. The installers were great and cleaned up after the job.Overall we are very satisfied

The sales person came to our home to discuss our requirements. The system was installed within the time frame given.Very efficient and friendlyOur provider has not installed the smart meter as yet, but this is through no fault of the installer. I will provide more feedback at a later date when we are up and running
An overall positive experience and enjoying the benefits at a great price

After some research / initial contacts with other companies I am glad to say we went with Matrix for our solar installation.Andrew and his guys were professional from start to finish.The system is working well for us and has been trouble free.The work was completed as quoted and on time.The installers were friendly, tidy and did a great job.We are happy to recommend this company to our friends and family.

Matrix Solar were punctual with call out, inspecting the installation site and discussing requirements. Very friendly and professional, quoted on site. Installation was also very punctual, quicker than expected, installers were very polite and friendly, keeping us informed of progress. Old system removed and taken away with no mess at all left behind. System connected to grid and monitoring set up on the day. Fantastic job. System is performing as expected.

The quote was done on time as agreed. Everything was explained ( as much as I understood).The actual installation was fast and the boys were lovely.Because of my energy provider, I had to initiate connection to the grid which wasn't hard with the info I had been provided with.If only I could  get the link to the app so I can see what my system is generating. That seems to be the only issue herennn

Installation solar with Matrix has been a great experience. The sales staff did a good presentation on the spot about the solar system and the price was competitive. Their installers were very professional. After installation, they, Andrew, helped to organize the grid connection. The system works so far so good.

This company was the only one who has contacted me the earliest, the man in charge personally visited the house, inspected the facilities, offered valuable advice. The installation was next day after I have accepted the quote. The only hiccup was the need to install curtailing controller from SwitchDin, which they have never done, as this is only needed in a few suburbs. This was done the following morning and my system started to generate solar power then.
Great  company  would  recommend too  everyone answered questions in easy to understand language

Everything was fabulous, and we love our system. It is already saving us money.The after sales support however has been a bit disappointing. I've emailed, phoned, and texted, to ask some more questions, but there has been no reply so far in the week after installation.
Very easy to deal with, responsive and able to address all questions and concerns we had with system and installation as we have exposed beam ceilings.

The sales/quoting process was simple, factual and honest. Any questions post quote and/or per-installation was addresses quickly via email and followed up by a call.I was lucky in that there had been a cancellation for an install with another client and I was able to get the system installed within a week of accepting the quote.The guys arrived at 07:30 and discussed all aspects of the installation answering any questions I had as and when asked and were extremely polite, punctual, efficient and tidy.Being an engineer it has been said that I am a little critical of all things related to tradies carrying out work on my property and I have to say I was very impressed with the whole job.Whilst I can't comment for other installers I can say that Matrix Solar Solutions exceeded my expectations and I am more than happy to recommend them to friends and family who are looking to install a solar system to their property.
Very helpful at a personal level with flexibility.I would use again  and if there are glitches, am sure they will be sorted.
Andrew was great help with getting the best system for our needs at the best price - helped us work through the new government inverter issues as well.
Quote was informative and up to dateinstallers where polite punctual and efficientthey organised grid connect

This business was very easy to deal with. Installation was clean and started shortly after signing up. Barely a n off cut of wire, 2cm was all that I found. They also took away the old panels from the previous solar system and completed the installation before the day end. The boss of the company came and set up the Fronius inverter so I can see on the app how the system is going.It works better than I expectedDesmond.

From the first phonecall I knew Andrew was knowledgeable and professional he personally came to our house and conducted a thorough site inspection and also physically measured our roof  to make sure the panels would fit he was a man of his word and all works where completed in a very prompt and professional manner i cannot stress enough how professional matrix solar solutions conduct themselves and their work speaks for itself i chose matrix solar solutions for their honesty and professionalism and have happily recommended them to friends and family
The process from the quote to installation was quick, easy & stress free.The installers were punctual, polite & did a perfect job.Would definitely recommend to anyone considering solar
Sales process clear and informative. Installation quick and early due to cancellation.Organised change of meter with energy provider.
All was well explained, polite, tidy and professional. Arrangements were sensible, all inclusive and adhered to.

The sales and quoting process went smooth and once the sales person had seen me the quote came the next day with plenty of information. After receiving all the quottes I decided to upgrade to an 8kw system where they provided a reqused quotation very quickly.The installation happened on the day that was agreed on once I accepted the quote and all of the installers were very professional, tidy and abided by required saftey rules.The system has only been installed for 4 days so we can not comment on any post completion service at the moment. Matrix did advise me to call them if I have any issues.
very profesional with the sale  explained the pros and cons bit of a delay with connection but not from their  side
Timely follow ups and good customer service from both salesman and installers

Installation went ahead earlier than the agreed date which was great. Took 5 weeks to have the meter changed over as a form was missed by the installer that needed to be signed. After having done this it took 2 weeks for the meter change to happen and have the system up and running

We used a solar website that gave us three solar companies that would call is for a quote.  Matrix was the first to call us and the only businessthat came out to our house for a face to face consultation.The installation went well the guys had it done within the day and were friendly and polite.  However there was a bit of rubbish left in our yard.After the getting the panels put on we had to contact matrix to follow up about the change over for the meter box and  the fixing of one of the panels on the roof. We have finally have our panels working after 5 weeks and we are still waiting for the book for the inverter after again contacting them with no reply. Overall the panels look great but the customer service is terrible.

Quoting staff friendly and courteous. Installation efficient and tidy. Connnection to grid has been difficult due to SA Legislation change 4 days prior to installation and confusion over metre changes.

The quoting process was very good, easy to understand and with your help we knew what type of system we wanted.The installation spanned over two days. They were very through  and respectful.The installers where polite and tidy and on time each time.The owner contacted us on the day and after installation to ensure we understood the process and were happy with the timelines.We already had the system installed before two of the preferred suppliers contacted us.Although we are very grateful for your assistance, information and support during the process.
